text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after spending time scouting
some
training grounds the academy owns
on an
uninhabited island...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean the ship home isn't
moving?!

text_block_list.name: Sailor
text_block_list.text:
We think it's likely a main system error
with the
autopilot function.

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text:
All of the other ships are either booked
or out for repairs. It looks like no one
will be able to come
for us until late
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Let me see it.
choice_data_list: It takes quite a bit of time, does...

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm? This is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no issue with the main system.
It's just a
low battery causing the control
system to fail.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I see. In other words, you're
saying a
Chupacabra has been set loose
in the South Pole?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I peered into an octopus pot to learn my
fortune.
It told me to catch squid for
good luck, so I
hitched a boat out here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But now, after I went through all the
trouble to catch some, you're telling me
I gotta wait until night?! These squids
and sea urchins are going to be
devastated if they lose their freshness!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What do I do, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We just need to charge the battery. If
we can find
a way to charge it, then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as their eyes meet, they both
set off
running. I have no idea what's
going on, but I
hurry after them.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaah!
I've got a lovely bunch of
coconuuuts! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This'll do. Coconuts have been attracting

attention for their potential use as a
biofuel.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Golshi has a ridiculously strong habit of
moving erratically... However, in times
like these, it can
be our ticket out of
disaster.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In other words, even Golshi has her uses!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew...
This is getting old...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
RN-Jackass... Still, everything's going to
plan.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Hand me that thing we
picked up on
the beach earlier!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho! What do we have here?! I
didn't
know there was such a thing as a
two-wheeled
pseudo-unicycle bicycle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
With no handlebars, you've gotta stick
your arms out when you ride it... This
thing is da bomb! It really gives you that
feeling you can only get from riding a
unicycle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Riiight, get on over here! I'm gonna
picture myself
on a French mountain
road while I ride it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur skillfully manipulates the 
unpredictable Gold Ship and continues
her
preparations for charging the ship's
battery.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whiiiir!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The coconuts are working out
surprisingly well. All I did was cobble
together some trash and imitate a
method I've seen before. ...Still, it's
working out all right.

text_block_list.name: Sailor
text_block_list.text: Aye, just a little more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bwooon! Chug, chug, chug...

text_block_list.name: Sailor
text_block_list.text: It's running! I've got signal too!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Let's get the hell outta here already. I'm
sick to
death of lookin' at the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through the combined efforts of Gold
Ship and
Air Shakur, we manage to make
it safely back to
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh pish posh! All in a day's work for the
great
Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, don't get too carried away. Any
idea how
tough it was for me to stay on
top of you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Excuse you! It was my astounding energy that saved the day, was it not?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Excuse you! It was my astounding energy that saved the day, was it not?!
choice_data_list: You two are pretty close after all...
You two are pretty close after all...
Anyway, I'm glad you made it back ...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Don't tell me her insanity has
rubbed off on
you!
choice_data_list: You two are pretty close after all...
You two are pretty close after all...
Anyway, I'm glad you made it back ...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: How meaaan! Sniff... And here I thought we had a grand friendship even the distant Venusians envy!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, shut up...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship has an eccentricity one might
call genius, which makes the two of them
surprisingly similar... Today, I've seen a
new side of Air
Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... We lost so much time. I need to
get this
data compiled right away.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Not so fast, Shakur! We haven't split
today's loot
yet! I'm haulin' it over now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I grabbed you a fir tree fashioned into a
New
Year's decoration to get you
through the winter
season!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Keep it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur doesn't exactly look pleased,
but it's
still been a more or less
memorable day!
